name: myka-quad-erp
description: Myka Quad mini ERP — React front end (source/) + API (server/) on a Cloudflare Worker (worker/) with a Cloudflare D1 database (db/)

scripts.test: node backend/test/api.test.js && TEST_D1=1 node backend/test/api.test.js && node backend/test/d1-concurrency.test.js && node backend/test/mailer.test.js
scripts.build:site: cd source && npx -y pnpm@10 install --frozen-lockfile && npx --no-install tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && npx --no-install parcel build index.html --dist-dir dist --no-source-maps && mkdir -p ../_site && npx --no-install html-inline dist/index.html > ../_site/index.html && cp ../config.js ../_site/config.js && cp -r ../site-extra/. ../_site/
